journey.title: An operator records income from a source with no API
journey.purpose: The journey that proves manual entry is first-class. Several real revenue sources — resale on marketplaces hostile to automation, consulting, cash — have no API anywhere, and a design where this path feels degraded fails for exactly those sources.

steps.intent: Add a money event by hand, choosing its account and book
See the basis set to operator-asserted automatically, and shown rather than hidden
See it listed beside adapter-sourced events in the identical shape
See position update with the new event's basis reflected in the inputs list
